block.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_mediteerkus: After the whole Guhvatar story: sit on it (click), close your eyes, and your soul goes to the Spirit World.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_ar: Maps, songs, recipes. Mostly recipes. Take a book with you.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_bi: Your soul sniffs further than your body: the Spirit World. Islands in the haze, lilac grass, water that falls upwards. You first go there in the story of the Water Tribe.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_ch: Open the seven chakras, one per zone, with Guru Pathik Guh as your guide. Reward: the Guhvatar glow.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_he: Hei Bai Guh is big and angry, because his forest burnt down. Make a Nibble Chorus Acorn and plant it by the burnt stump.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_kl: Ring the giant bell between the two islands. Then it gets quiet. Very quiet.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_ko: Answer the three riddles of Koh the Face Stealer. Don't move. Don't jump. Feel nothing.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_ku: After the whole story you can always go back: sit on a meditation cushion and close your eyes. From a meditation stone you travel (with shift) to buildings you know.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_la: Bring all eight lost little lantern spirits back to the Lantern Tree. Click a lantern and it follows you.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_le: Listen to the old members of the order. The founder gives you the tile that belongs to nobody.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_po: Lay the nine turning tiles before the gate as a white lotus, and walk into the court.
The Gate of the White Lotus
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_pr: Pass the trials of Bumi Guh, Pakguh, Piandao Guh, Jeong Jeong Guh and Uncle Miroh. Every trial gives a Pai Sho tile.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_re: Lay the six tiles on the pedestals. Something very big wakes up.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_sp: Look into a mirror pond. The water shows something far away. Or yourself.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_ve: A white heron, a golden knowledge fox, Koh in the mist and a moon night. Look closely: they're gone again in no time.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_vo: Follow the glowing footsteps of something invisible to three little secrets.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_geest_spel_wa: A hooded figure watches you, far away. Follow him, until a path appears to the eighth island.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.beloning.libe: A little dragonfly bunny guh that travels with you
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.bloei: All over the Spirit World you feel it: the wood is in bloom, the Lantern Tree glows, and curious little spirits come to see who did all that.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.boek.pagina.1:
FROM THE LOTUS ARCHIVE

Written down by the Old Heron, for whoever brought the six tiles together.

Read slowly. With tea.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.boek.pagina.2: Four guhs, four nations, one Pai Sho table. That is how the White Lotus began: not with a sword, but with a cup that was passed along.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.boek.pagina.3: The order kept what the war wanted to forget: books, songs, the way to hidden temples, and the recipe for the perfect jasmine tea (page 812).
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.boek.pagina.4: When the Guhvatar went "for a quick chonk" in a cheese ball for a hundred years, we waited. An order that drinks tea can wait a very long time.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.boek.pagina.5: Far out in the mist lies an eighth island. There, say the oldest scrolls, someone once shared his last nibble. And there everything began, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.1.les: What are you afraid of? Look at it calmly, and lay it down here. Being afraid is allowed. You just don't have to lug it around.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.2.les: Something you once did wrong is still sitting in your tummy. Forgive yourself, the way you'd forgive a friend who dropped their nibble.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.3.les: What are you ashamed of? What you never dare say about yourself weighs the most. Say it in your head, and let it burn until it's gone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.4.les: Grief for whoever or whatever you have lost may flow. Love doesn't go away. It only changes shape, like clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.5.les: Don't lie to yourself. Not even about how many nibbles you've already eaten. Especially not about that.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.6.les: You see the world as separate pieces: air folk, water folk, guhs, Mikas. Look again. It is one whole. And you belong to it.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.7.les: What are you holding on to the tightest? Open your paw. Only an empty paw can catch something new.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.7.naam: The chakra of thought: letting go.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.bewoge: You moved. The little gate closes again. Sit down again and be still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.eerst: Chakra %s first. The little gates only open in order.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.gloed: All seven chakras are open. A soft light comes around you: the Guhvatar glow. Click a chakra stone to switch it on or off.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.guru.1: Ah, there you are! I am the echo of Guru Pathik Guh. I've been waiting for you. A while. Actually a very long while.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.guru.2: In your soul are seven little gates, chakras. They're blocked by old things: fear, guilt, sadness... and crumbs. Mostly crumbs.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.guru.3: In every zone stands a chakra stone. Start with the first one, here beside me. Sit down, be still, and let go.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.guru.k: All seven open. I can see it in your glow. Would you like a bowl of onion soup? No? That's fine too.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.guru.v: You have %s of the %s open. Go to the next chakra stone. Take your time, the little gates aren't going anywhere.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.1: You sit down by the chakra stone of earth. Breathe in. Breathe out. Don't get up.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.2: You sit down by the chakra stone of water. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.3: You sit down by the chakra stone of fire. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.4: You sit down by the chakra stone of air. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.5: You sit down by the chakra stone of sound. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.6: You sit down by the chakra stone of light. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.chakra.zit.7: You sit down by the last chakra stone, the one of thought. Breathe in. Breathe out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.gast.gids: %s guests are travelling with you in the Spirit World.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.gast.mee: You were standing next to %s when they began to meditate. You're coming along as a guest!
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.gast.wakker: %s woke up. So do you: the Spirit World gently lets you go.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.geestentij.be: The mist turns deep blue. The lanterns glow brighter. And very far away, in the haze, shapes bigger than mountains are moving.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.geheim.1: The paw prints stop at a little dish of nibbles. An offering, from someone who was here long ago. There's a note: "For whoever followed me. Enjoy."
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.geheim.2: The paw prints stop. In the distance stands a guh in a hood. He nods. He brought you here.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.geheim.3: At the end of the trail lies a nest of warm mist. Something invisible slept here, and left something tasty behind.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.geheim.nog: Something's here. But you haven't found the way to it yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.1: Hei Bai Guh rises above you: black, huge, with six arms and a white mask for a face. He roars. But in his eyes you don't see anger. You see sadness.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.2: Around him there's a smell of smoke. Not here: in the real world. His forest, the forest he protected, has burnt down.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.3: A spirit without a forest no longer knows who he is. Maybe something that smells of home will help: an acorn from the Guheinde.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.groei: A young sapling is growing from the stump. It hums.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.help: I'll help you, Hei Bai Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.klaar: Hei Bai Guh is small and sweet again. The Whispering Wood whispers something else now: thank you.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.nog: Hei Bai Guh sniffs. He's waiting for something that smells of home.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.opdra: Pick a Nibble Chorus Fruit in the Nibble Chorus Forest and shell it with a Cheese Nibble in your crafting table: inside is an acorn. Plant it by the burnt stump.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.plant: Plant the acorn by the burnt stump (click it).
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hei_bai.stron: A burnt stump in a ring of young saplings. Something ought to grow here.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.1: Chakra stone 1 stands %s, right by the arrival, next to Guru Pathik Guh. Talk to him first; then click the stone and sit still until the five dots are full.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.2: Chakra stone 2 stands %s, in the Whispering Wood (the black-and-white striped trees, west of the arrival). Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.3: Chakra stone 3 stands %s, by Koh's Cave under the big black tree. Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.4: Chakra stone 4 stands %s, on the rim of the Sky Pond: the pond that hangs in the air, east of the arrival. Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.5: Chakra stone 5 stands %s, in the garden by the Tea Pavilion, southeast of the arrival. Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.6: Chakra stone 6 stands %s, in the garden of the old members, behind the gate of the White Lotus (the southwest corner of the court). Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.chakra.7: The last chakra stone stands %s, high up on the Peak of the Predecessors: climb the Sky Stair by the White Lotus Ruins. Click it and sit still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.eikel: The burnt stump stands %s. First make a Nibble Chorus Acorn at your crafting table (a nibble chorus fruit from the Nibble Chorus Forest of the Guheinde and a cheese nibble) and click the stump with it.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.hei_bai: Hei Bai Guh stands %s, in a clearing with a burnt stump in the Whispering Wood: the wood with the black-and-white striped trees, west of the arrival. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.koh: Koh's Cave lies %s, under the big black tree (the way in is on the south side). Stand on the spot before Koh, click him and stand stock-still: when the dots above your hotbar are full, he asks his riddle.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lantaarn: A lost little lantern spirit floats %s (the column of light points it out). Click it and it follows you; bring it to the Lantern Tree at the arrival. If one already floats behind you, the column points to the tree.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.ar: The stone lotus is open. The stairs to the Lotus Archive are %s, behind the lotus. Walk down.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.ho: The gate is open. Walk through it to the north, into the court (%s): the floor is a great Pai Sho board.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.le: The old members of the order are waiting %s, in their garden in the southwest corner of the court. Click all three, and then go to the founder Wen Li Guh, before the sanctuary on the north side.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.po: The gate of the White Lotus lies %s: follow the path with the lanterns north, to the ruins with the broken columns. Before the gate nine tiles lie in the floor. Click a tile to turn it; a tile that lies right sparkles green. When together they lie as a white lotus, the gate opens.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.pr: The next trial is waiting %s. Click the master's echo (a see-through, glowing guh) to begin.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.lotus.vo: The sanctuary lies %s, on the north side of the court. Click each of the six pedestals before the stone lotus: that lays a tile on it.
Next trial: %1$s, in the west wing of the court (%2$s). Three rooms that turn: click him to begin.
Next trial: %1$s, in the northeast wing with the candles (%2$s). Click him to begin.
Next trial: %1$s, in the tea garden in the southeast corner of the court (%2$s). Click him to begin.
Next trial: %1$s, in the east wing of the court (%2$s). Mirrors of ice and moonlight: click him to begin.
Next trial: %1$s, in the northwest wing by the forge (%2$s). A duel on the beat: click him to begin.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.wan.eila: The path in the mist is there! It begins %s, beyond the Whispering Wood. Follow the stones to the eighth island, to the foot of the old tree.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.hint.wan.pad: The eighth island lies far out in the mist in the southwest. The path to it begins %s, beyond the Whispering Wood, but it only appears once you have all six Pai Sho tiles and all seven chakras are open (or after the whole Guhvatar story).
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.rust: The Spirit Bell is still humming.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.0: All the lantern spirits wink at you at the same time. Then they pretend nothing happened.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.1: Very far away, a koi sings back.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.2: For a moment you don't know which way is up. Then you do again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.3: Leaves are blowing upwards, not down.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.4: In the distance stands someone in a hood. He heard the bell too.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.klok.vreemd.5: Your shadow waves at you. You didn't wave.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.dichterbi: Come and stand before Koh, at the riddle spot.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.emotie.0: "Ah... there was something. A twitch of your ear." Koh turns his head away. Try again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.emotie.1: "You moved. Moving is feeling." Koh taps with a thousand little feet. Again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.emotie.2: "Interesting... fear? Impatience? I collect them all." Don't worry, your face is still there. Again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.masker: Koh lays something down in front of you: a mask without feeling. "So you have one after all, from me. You may keep your own face."
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.na.0: You again. With that same face. I still find it lovely.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.na.1: I once took the face of someone who laughed at my joke. I don't make jokes any more.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.na.2: Go. Or stay. But feel nothing.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.nog: Koh's faces start changing again. %s riddle(s) to go. Stand still.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.raadsel.1: No. My faces are mine. I took them.
A mirror. Yes. It shows them all, and keeps not a single one.
I have a thousand faces, and not one of them is mine. What am I?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.raadsel.2: Wrong. Whoever takes nibbles leaves only crumbs behind. And not many.
Footsteps. You left many behind on your way to me.
The more of them you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.raadsel.3: Wrong. That I can. I just don't. Usually.
...Yes. A face that shows nothing, I cannot take. That is why you are still standing here.
What can even I not take?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.stil: Koh's faces are changing... Don't move. Don't jump. Feel nothing.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.koh.welkom: A visitor... with a face. What a lovely face. Would you like to hear my riddles? Then you may feel nothing. Nothing at all.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.al_hie: Your soul is already in the Spirit World.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.cadeau: There's a meditation cushion in your bag. After a story like that you can always go back to the Spirit World: sit on it and close your eyes.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.misluk: Your soul can't find the Spirit World right now. Try again in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.nog_ni: Your soul stays at home for now. After the whole Guhvatar story you can meditate here.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.ogen_d: You close your eyes... breathe in... breathe out... (stay seated)
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.kussen.wakker: You opened your eyes again. Sit down and stay still for a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lantaarn.klaa: All eight little lantern spirits hang on the Lantern Tree again. The tree lights up completely, and a tiny dragonfly bunny guh decides that from now on you are its friend.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lantaarn.thui: Home! %s of the %s lanterns hang on the tree again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lantaarn.uitl: Bring the lantern spirit to the Lantern Tree in the Meditation Circle. There it hangs itself back up.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lantaarn.volg: The little lantern spirit winks and floats after you.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.gehoord: You listened to %s of the %s old members.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_1.1: I am Sao Guh, keeper of the scrolls. When the Fire Nation set the libraries ablaze, we carried the books away. In our ears, nyeg. Guh ears are big.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_1.2: Not everything could be saved. But what we saved is in the archive behind the stone lotus.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_1.3: A book nobody reads is only sleeping. Come and wake it one day.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_2.1: I am Mei Guh. I drew the maps of the order: secret roads, hidden tea houses, and where the tastiest nibbles grew.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_2.2: You know a member of the White Lotus by a tile. Show it, and you get a roof, tea and a friend. Anywhere.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_2.3: My most beautiful map is of a place nobody has ever reached: an island in the mist, at the edge of this world.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_3.1: I am old Pao Guh. I invented the opening "The Chonky Lotus". You put down all your pieces and then lie down for a very long time.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_3.2: Everyone laughed. Until they had to play against it. Patience is a weapon, youngster. The tastiest weapon there is.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lid.lid_3.3: During the hundred years the Guhvatar was missing, we kept the lotus burning. So that you could stand here now.
It began with a quarrel. Four nations, borders everywhere, and nobody talking to each other any more. Except at a Pai Sho table.
There we sat: an air nomad, a water guh, an earth guh and me, from the Fire Nation. We agreed on nothing. Except the tea.
Then we swore: what the world forgets, we keep. What the world tears apart, we bring together again. With tea, with patience, and with a great many games of Pai Sho.
First listen to the others. An order is not the story of one guh alone. You've heard %s of the %s.
First earn the tiles of the five masters. Only when they trust you can the order trust you too.
Ah. A new face at our board. Welcome, Guhvatar. I am Wen-Li Guh. I founded this order, long ago, when Roku Guh was still young.
Six tiles, six times trust. The Old Heron will be glad to be allowed to wake up.
Five masters trust you. Here: the White Lotus Tile. It belongs to nobody, and fits everywhere. Just like us.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.archief: The Lotus Archive. Shelves full of scrolls, maps of places that no longer exist, and a very thick recipe book. You get a book to take with you: "From the Lotus Archive".
A door without a handle. It only opens when the stone lotus opens.
The Lotus Archive is open. Walk inside.
Maps, songs, recipes. Mostly recipes. You could read here for hours.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.hof: The court of the White Lotus. The floor is a giant Pai Sho board, and around the court lie five wings.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.hof2: In every wing the echo of a master is waiting. Whoever passes the five trials gets five tiles. What the tiles open? You'll find out.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.lotus_d: A stone lotus, closed like a bud. Around it, coiled up, something very big lies asleep.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.lotus_o: The stone lotus stands open. Behind it lies the Lotus Archive.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.naar_vo: Six tiles. Before the stone lotus stand six empty pedestals. Lay the tiles on them, one by one.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.poort_b: The gate is shut. Lay the tiles as a lotus first.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.poort_d: The gate stays shut. On the threshold it says: "Lay the tiles as a lotus, and the gate will know you are a friend."
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.poort_o: The nine tiles lie as a lotus. The gate sighs, and slides open.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.poort_s: The nine tiles form a white lotus
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.puzzel_: Tiles right: %s of %s (the middle one is always right)
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.tegels_: Creak... the nine tiles turn over. The gate wants to know if you are a friend too: turn them until together they form a white lotus.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.vijf: Five tiles. The old members of the order are whispering in the court. They want to tell you something.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.lotus.voetstu: %s belongs here. You don't have it yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.maannacht.beg: The light turns silver. Everywhere the spirits look up... Tui, the Moon Spirit, comes down through the mist. (Hurry to the Sky Pond!)
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.mist: The mist thickens and gently pushes you back. You're not welcome here yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.mist.archief: The door of the archive stays shut. Something big is still asleep in front of it.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.mist.eiland: The mist holds you back. That island is not for you (yet).
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.moeras.visioe: For a moment someone you know stands among the roots of the swamp. You blink... and there's only mist.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.moeras_visioe: Roots, mist and silence. You saw something here. Or someone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.al: You've done this room already. You need room %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.be: I'll think like a mad old king!
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.di: Hehehe. Through the gate first, youngster. Then we'll talk.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.ee: Room %s first, nyeg. Even Bumi Guh starts at the beginning. Usually.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.ge: HAHAHA! You've got it! You're as mad as I am. That's the nicest compliment I have.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.in: HA! Visitors! I am the echo of Bumi Guh, king of Omashguh. Or I'm the real one, and you're the echo. Who's to say?
My trial: three rooms that turn. In every room, the most obvious answer is... wrong.
Think like a mad old king! Click the sparkling turning stone in the first room.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.ka: At the door that says EXIT.
I look for a secret button behind a painting.
I stand still and wait for the exit to turn past.
That door says EXIT. So of course that's NOT where it is! The room turns the wrong way.
Exactly! Why would you walk when the room does the work? Hehehe.
This room turns. Where is the exit?
The DO NOT PULL one, of course.
PULL HERE, it says so, doesn't it?
The plain lever, to be safe.
Hmmm, no. A sign that tells you what to do is a sign that wants something. Never trust signs, nyeg.
HA! Whoever hangs up a sign like that wants you to pull it. Otherwise he wouldn't have made a sign!
Three levers. The first one says: DO NOT PULL. The second: PULL HERE. The third is just a lever. Which one?
With earthbending. I push it away.
I go and stand somewhere else. Then the mountain is somewhere else by itself.
Boring! Anyone would do that. Anyone isn't mad enough. Again!
YES! The mountain stays where it is, and yet it's gone. The world turns, youngster, not the mountain.
Last room. A mountain is in the way. How do you get past?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.kl: The rooms are still turning a little. Bumi Guh is still laughing.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.na: Want another room? I've got one somewhere that hangs upside down.
You know what I like best? Crystal candy. And riddles. And crystal candy.
Say hello to Omashguh for me! And tell the post guh the slide is still too slow.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.st: Bumi Guh chuckles. Click the sparkling turning stone in the first room.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.bumi.vo: The room turns! On to room %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.einde_k: You passed this trial. The master nods, content.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.einde_n: A trial ends here. Begin it with the master's echo.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.jeong_j: Fire waits. So do you. The gate first.
Every candle burns, and not one leaf is scorched. You master the fire. The fire does not master you. That is all.
I am the echo of Jeong Jeong Guh. I ran away from the Fire Nation's army, because I understood fire too well.
Fire is life, but it also wants to eat everything. Light the candles, one by one. Wait until the flame is calm (you hear a soft little bell) before you light the next.
Light one too soon and the wild flame licks at a lotus leaf and goes out again. Nothing burns. Except your patience.
The candles burn calmly. Jeong Jeong Guh almost smiles.
Are you hungry? I always am. Fire makes you hungry.
Fire can warm, cook and give light. Let everyone forget that, except you.
I once saw a princess here who shot fire without breathing. I hope one day she learns to breathe.
The flames are calm. You may light the next one.
Click a candle to light it. Breathe. Wait. Then the next.
Too fast. See how the lotus leaf curls? That last flame went out again. Wait for the bell and light it again.
You wanted too much at once. So did I, once. That last flame is out: calmly, once more.
Hm. Smoke. No disaster, just a lesson. Light that candle once more, when the bell rings.
The flame is still wild... breathe in... breathe out...
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.d: Ah, a guest! Come through the gate first. The tea won't get any colder, I promise.
HAHAHA! I've never heard it like that! You know what, that's actually true too. Good tea!
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.e: Ah, just so. Very good. This will be a good cup of tea.
Wisdom first, then tea. Click Uncle Miroh or the tea table.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.g: Ah, falling. You know, falling isn't an end, but...
...a fine moment for a little lie-down. With a nibble.
...a new beginning, with a little more wisdom in your backpack.
...a kind of cheese.
Jasmine... ahh. The spinning stops. Tomorrow I'll jump again, but smarter.
The Falling Spirit
I want to fly. Every day I jump off the waterfall, and every day I fall. My head is still spinning.
Yuck! That only makes my head spin more.
The Falling Spirit wants something calming, for a spinning head. Something with flowers.
Sometimes life is a dark corridor, and you can't see the light yet. But...
...corridors have feelings too.
...you can always eat your own lantern. No wait, don't.
...whoever keeps walking, step by step, ends up somewhere brighter all by themselves.
Ginger! I can feel my ears again. I'll just keep walking. Step by step.
The Tunnel Spirit
I live in a dark corridor. I can't see the end. I don't know whether to keep walking. And I'm cold.
Brr. That's lukewarm. My corridor doesn't get any warmer from that.
The Tunnel Spirit is cold. Something warm, something spicy.
Wisdom that comes from only one spring becomes...
...stiff and stale. Taste from another spring too.
...a spring with wisdom in it. Obviously.
...as dull as tea from one tea bag. Take a second bag, nyeg.
Ginseng! I'm awake. Say, what do you think, actually? I really want to know.
The Hermit Spirit
I only listen to myself. I already know everything. But I'm so tired of myself.
Hmpf. That only makes me sleepier.
The Hermit Spirit is tired, so tired. Something that wakes you up.
Three contented spirits, three empty cups. Drinking tea with a guh you've just met is one of the true chonky joys of life. This tile is yours.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.i: Welcome to my tea garden! I am... a dream of Uncle Miroh. I'm still alive, you know. Somewhere I'm drinking tea right now. This is me too, only dreaming.
Three spirits are sitting at my table with a problem. I begin a wisdom, and you finish it. Pick the right ending, or a funny one. Nonsense gives nasty tea.
And then you pour each spirit the tea that suits it. Come, sit down.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.k: The tea garden is quiet and content. There's still a cup waiting for you.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.n: Did you know jasmine tea tastes better when you drink it with a friend? That's science.
I hope that I, the real me, gets a tea shop one day. With a bell on the door.
Tell my nephew not to look so sour at his tea. Then it tastes sour too.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.o: Hmm. This tea tastes of socks. Try again.
I... don't think that's a wisdom. I think that's a shopping list.
An interesting answer. As interesting as lukewarm tea. Once more?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.miroh.s: Now pour %s the right tea: click the right teapot.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.niet_nu: The echoes of the White Lotus are waiting for whoever has come through the gate.
I'll turn the mirrors.
Mirror %1$s glints: it points %2$s, the light has to go %3$s (to %4$s). %5$s of %6$s right.
The moonlight leaps from mirror to mirror and touches the necklace. The running water freezes into a glittering path.
Click the necklace
The water freezes!
Hm. Through the gate first. And shave your mustache. Oh, you don't have one.
the necklace
mirror %s
The necklace lies in the dark. The moonlight has to reach it first.
First talk to Pakguh's echo, at the entrance of his wing.
Hmph. Let me blow. Hoooo... Mirror %s is right. Don't tell the others I helped. Nyeg.
Psst. Look at the mirror the light falls on: mirror %1$s, the one with the column of light. Click it until its white arrow points %2$s, to %3$s. Patience, like water.
I am the echo of Master Pakguh of the Northern Water Tribe. Yes, my mustache is an echo too. It's still just as handsome.
In my wing stand mirrors of ice. Turn them so the moonlight leaps from mirror to mirror until it touches the necklace.
Water is patient, but it never gives up. Be like water. Click a mirror to turn it.
This necklace... I carved it myself once. From a river stone, for a guh I loved very much. Kanna Guh.
She didn't want to marry because that was how things were done. She wanted to choose for herself. She left, for the south. I was stubborn. Too stubborn.
Even an icy master has a heart that once melted. Remember that, when someone is strict with you.
The mirrors gleam, content. So does Pakguh, though he doesn't show it.
Your water whip is still a bit limp. But your heart, that's good.
I always said: only guhs with a mustache. I think I was wrong. Don't tell anyone.
If you ever see Kanna Guh... tell her the necklace still shines.
All mirrors are right! Click the necklace.
The moonlight isn't here yet. First mirror %s, the one that glints.
south
west
north
east
The light jumps to %1$s! Now it's mirror %2$s's turn.
Mirror %s is already right: it passes the light on. It stays that way.

The moonlight falls on mirror 1 from above. Click the mirror that glints: it turns a quarter. The white arrow shows where the light goes now. Make it jump to the next mirror, until it hits the necklace with the blue glow.
Mirrors of ice
Click the mirror that glints
Mirror %1$s now points %2$s. The light has to go %3$s, to %4$s. Click again.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.piandao: You've already won this duel.
I'm ready.
A duel begins with a bow. And with walking through the gate.
Fallen from a star, carried by you. This tile will never break. Wear it with pride, and without arrogance.
%s of the %s. Your sword sings. Come, we're going to forge something.
Duel won!
Welcome. I am the echo of Piandao Guh, sword master. A sword is not a weapon but a pen. You write your character with it.
We duel to the beat of the music. When I raise my sword, you hear it swish. Click exactly on the next beat: that's a parry.
Three rounds, each one faster. Parry eight of the twelve. Ready? Then I'll put you on the duelling spot.
A little spark still glows in the forge.
Easy. A sword that just swings about says nothing. Click me again when you want to start over.
You lift the piece of meteorite. It is heavy, and a little warm.
A piece of meteorite, black and glittering. Piandao Guh first wants to see how you duel.
A good sword is like a good conversation: you know when to stop.
I once taught a prince. He was headstrong. He became a good guh.
Practise every day. Even if it's just with a stick and a Cheese Nibble.
Lift the piece of meteorite and bring it to the forge.
Lift the meteorite and bring it to the forge
Another duel? You are already on the right spot. Listen for the swish, and click on the beat after it.
Parry! (%s of %s)
Round %s!
You won the duel. Now bring the piece of meteorite to the forge, and we'll forge your tile.
The fire of the forge is burning. Only a piece of meteorite is missing.
Piandao Guh bows. Listen to the beat... and click when his sword comes down.
Tap! A little tap on your ear. It didn't hurt.
Rhythm Duel
Click one beat after the swish, as his sword falls. %s of %s is enough.
Off the beat...
%s parries, and I asked for %s. No shame in that. Again? Click me.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.proef.tegel: You get %s! (%s of the %s master tiles)
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.reis.aangekom: You open your eyes at %s. Your body travelled along, as it does in this world.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.reis.kies: Where shall your soul wake up?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.reis.niets: Your soul doesn't know a building to travel to yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.reis.onbekend: Your soul looks for %s, but can't find the way yet. Try again in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.reis.tip: (Tip: hold shift and click a meditation stone to travel to a Guhvatar building you know.)
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.spiegel.gebou: The water shows %s, very far away and very close.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.spiegel.kop: In the still water you see...
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.spiegel.zelf: The water shows yourself: with glowing eyes and a soft light around you. Is that who you are, or who you're becoming?
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.voetstappen.b: Glowing little paw prints walk ahead of you. Of something you can't see. Follow them...
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.vosje.niets: The knowledge fox sniffs at you and yawns. There's nothing left that you haven't found.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.vosje.snuffel: The knowledge fox sniffs, turns three circles, and points with its little snout: that way!
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.daar: There, in the distance... a hooded figure.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.drie: Every time you saw the figure, he was looking the same way: towards the eighth island in the mist. That's where he wants you. But there's no way yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.glimp.1: A hooded figure. He looks at you. Then he's gone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.glimp.2: There he is again. He seems to be waiting for something.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.klaar: You hold the first nibble in your paw. It is made of stone, and yet warm.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan.pad: Far out in the mist something lights up. A path, stone by stone, to the eighth island. It is there only for you.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.wan_onthullin: An old stone, worn smooth by paws, a very long time ago.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.zicht.koh.gez: Deep in the mist, Koh crawls past, slowly, far away. He doesn't see you. You think. Something glints where he was.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.zicht.maan.ge: A moon night. You catch a drop of the silver light.
A white heron, bigger than a house, glides silently through the mist. A feather drifts down towards you.
gui.guhs.einde2_geest_spel.zicht.vosje.g: A golden knowledge fox! It drops a scroll and is gone before you can wiggle your ears.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.0: Meditate at chakra stone 1: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.1: Meditate at chakra stone 2: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.2: Meditate at chakra stone 3: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.3: Meditate at chakra stone 4: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.4: Meditate at chakra stone 5: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.5: Meditate at chakra stone 6: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.6: Meditate at chakra stone 7: click it, sit still until the dots are full, and let go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.nu.klaar: All seven little gates are open. The Guhvatar glow is yours.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.uitleg: Guru Pathik Guh waits by the first meditation stone. Seven little gates in your soul, blocked by old crumbs: open them one by one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.0: by the arrival, next to Guru Pathik Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.1: the Whispering Wood, west of the arrival
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.2: by Koh's Cave, under the big black tree
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.3: the rim of the Sky Pond, east of the arrival
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.4: the garden by the Tea Pavilion, to the southeast
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.5: the garden of the old members of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_chakra.waar.6: the Peak of the Predecessors, at the top of the Sky Stair
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.nu.0: Find Hei Bai Guh in the clearing with the burnt stump and click him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.nu.1: Make a Nibble Chorus Acorn at your crafting table (nibble chorus fruit + cheese nibble) and click the burnt stump with it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.nu.klaar: Hei Bai Guh is small and sweet again, and the wood is in bloom.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.uitleg: In the Whispering Wood lives Hei Bai Guh, a forest spirit who has grown very big and very angry. Something happened to his forest in the real world.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.waar.0: the Whispering Wood, west of the arrival
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_hei_bai.waar.1: the Nibble Chorus Forest in the Guheinde, then the Whispering Wood
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.nu.0: Stand on the spot before Koh, click him and stand stock-still until the dots above your hotbar are full.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.nu.2: The last riddle. Your face is still yours: keep it that way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.nu.klaar: Koh gave you a mask. You got to keep your own face.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.uitleg: Koh the Face Stealer has riddles. He only asks them of someone who shows no feeling at all. Don't move. Don't jump. Don't sneeze.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.waar.0: Koh's Cave, under the big black tree (northwest)
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.waar.1: Koh's Cave, under the big black tree (northwest)
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_koh.waar.2: Koh's Cave, under the big black tree (northwest)
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.0: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (0 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.1: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (1 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.2: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (2 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.3: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (3 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.4: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (4 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.5: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (5 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.6: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (6 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.7: Bring the lost lanterns back to the Lantern Tree at the arrival (7 of 8 hang there again). Click a lantern and it follows you; a column of light points out the next one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.nu.kla: All eight hang on the tree again. It glows, and a little dragonfly bunny guh travels with you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_lantaarns.uitleg: Eight little lantern spirits wandered off from the Lantern Tree. Click a lost lantern and it follows you. Bring it back to the tree in the Meditation Circle.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_verschijningen.n: Look around carefully. There are four rare sightings.
Three rare sightings you haven't seen yet.
Two more. They love silence and mist.
One more. Sometimes the light suddenly turns silver...
You've seen all four. Few guhs can say that.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_verschijningen.u: Wander the Spirit World long enough and sometimes you see something that is almost never there. Look closely: it is gone again in no time.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.nu.0: Take a good look at the hooded figure when he is there.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.nu.1: Far out in the mist lies an island nobody reaches. The path to it only appears once you have all six Pai Sho tiles and all seven chakras are open (or after the whole story).
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.nu.2: A path has appeared, beyond the Whispering Wood. Follow it to the eighth island.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.nu.klaar: Now you know where it all began.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.uitleg: A guh in a hood sometimes stands far away, watching you. Come closer, and he's gone.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.waar.1: the mist in the southwest, beyond the Whispering Wood
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_wan.waar.2: the eighth island, in the southwest
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.0: Turn the nine tiles before the gate (click them) until together they form a white lotus. A tile that lies right sparkles green.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.1: Walk north through the open gate into the court with the great Pai Sho board.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.2: Earn the tile of every master: click his glowing echo in his wing. Bumi Guh (west), Pakguh (east), Piandao Guh (northwest), Jeong Jeong Guh (northeast) and Uncle Miroh (the tea garden, southeast).
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.3: Listen to the three old members in their garden (the southwest corner of the court), and then to the founder before the sanctuary.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.4: Click each of the six pedestals before the stone lotus: that is how you lay your tiles on them.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.5: Walk down the stairs behind the open stone lotus, into the Lotus Archive.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.nu.k: The order trusts you. So does the Old Heron. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.uitl: Behind the gate with the turning puzzle lies the old court of the White Lotus: five wings, five masters, five trials. And somewhere behind them, something very big is sleeping.
gui.guhs.verhalen.geest_witte_lotus.waar: the White Lotus Ruins, north of the arrival
the White Lotus Ruins, behind the gate
the five wings around the court
the court of the White Lotus
the sanctuary, on the north side of the court
behind the stone lotus, in the sanctuary
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_eerste_knabb: A nibble of stone, warm as a paw. From the very first Guhvatar.
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_gouden_rol.l: Dropped from the mouth of a golden knowledge fox. Something is written on it that you can't read yet.
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_knabbelkoor_: A little acorn from the heart of a Nibble Chorus Fruit. It hums softly.
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_koh_masker.l: A face without feeling, a gift from Koh. On your head you look very mysterious.
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_koh_schub.lo: Koh crawled past in the mist and left this behind. It is cold and smooth.
A drop of silver light from the moon night. It glows when you're not looking.
item.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_veer.lore: A feather so light it falls a little bit upwards.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_bumi.lore: A tile with an upside-down mountain. According to Bumi Guh that's the right way up.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_jeong_jeong: Jeong Jeong Guh's Pai Sho Tile
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_jeong_jeong.lore: Warm, but never hot. A little flame that behaves itself.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_miroh.lore: It smells a little of jasmine tea. Always.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_pakguh.lore: Cool as ice, with a little wave and, very small, a mustache.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_piandao.lore: Forged from a piece of meteorite. It rings like a sword when you tap it.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tegel_witte_lotus.lore: The tile that belongs to nobody and fits everywhere. On the back, very small, two guh ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_geestenklok: Everything is quiet. No whispering, no tinkling. Every spirit turns around and looks at you.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_hei_bai_blo: You press the Nibble Chorus Acorn into the burnt earth. It hums softly.
Hei Bai Guh leans over and sniffs. He smells... home.
Where the giant stood, a small, round forest spirit is now sitting. All around the stump, shoots spring up. The wood is in bloom.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_archie: The stairs down, behind the stone lotus.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_chakra: Click the stone and sit still.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_hof.te: The court: five wings, five masters.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_koh.te: Stand here, click Koh, and feel nothing.
They want to tell you something. Listen to all three.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_pad.te: One day a path begins here, into the mist.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_pad_op: Stone by stone, to the eighth island.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_puzzel: Nine tiles. Turn them until together they form a white lotus.
The Gate of the White Lotus
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_vleuge: Bumi Guh: three rooms that turn.
Jeong Jeong Guh: candles, with patience.
The Wing of Jeong Jeong Guh
Pakguh: mirrors of ice and moonlight.
Piandao Guh: a duel on the beat.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_kijk_voetst: Six empty pedestals before the stone lotus.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_maannacht.m: The light turns silver. Through the mist Tui comes down, the Moon Spirit, white and silent.
The Sky Pond glows. All the spirits look up. For a moment, it is full moon everywhere.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_pakguh_uitl: Every winter I watched the moon from the ice. I once made this puzzle for a guh I never forgot. Pay attention: I'll explain it once. Well, as often as it takes.
There the moonlight falls in, right onto the first mirror. Click a mirror and it turns a quarter.
A mirror sends the light the way it points: that white arrow. Turn it until the light jumps to the next mirror. Whoever glints, it's their turn.
After the sixth mirror the light must hit the necklace, there in the corner, where it glows blue. Then the water freezes.
And if you get stuck, I'll blow you a hint. My mustache helps too. A little.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r1: On the six pedestals the tiles begin to glow, one by one. The air trembles.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r10: The Old Heron bows its long neck. Behind it, the door of the Lotus Archive slides open.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r2: The stone lotus creaks, and unfolds. Petal by petal, like a flower that has waited for ages.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r3: Six tiles... Six times trust. It is long since anyone brought them together, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r4: I am the Old Heron. I watched over the meetings of the White Lotus, here, where no war can reach.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r5: Long ago, four guhs from four nations sat at one Pai Sho table, in the middle of a quarrel that was tearing the whole world apart. They found out they all loved the same tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r6: They swore: what the world forgets, we keep. What the world tears apart, we bring together again. With tea. And a great deal of patience.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r7: When the Guhvatar had vanished for a hundred years, they kept the lotus burning. Bumi Guh, Pakguh, Piandao Guh, Jeong Jeong Guh... and a round guh with a beard who always made too much tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r8: Behind me lies the Lotus Archive: everything the order ever saved. Maps, songs, recipes. Mostly recipes.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_reiger.r9: And one more thing. Far out in the mist lies an island nobody can reach. That is where it all began. I don't know whether you'll ever find it, Guhvatar... but I hope so.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w1: The eighth island. The mist is quiet here, as if it's listening.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w10: Never forget it, Guhvatar. The greatest power is not taking. It is sharing. Even the last nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w11: Wan Guh smiles, and dissolves into a thousand little lights. On the stone lies a nibble of stone, warm as a paw.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w2: You followed me. All this time. Good.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w3: The figure pushes back his hood. Two ears. An ordinary guh, with very, very old eyes.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w4: I am Wan Guh. Long before the first temple, long before the first Fire Lord, I was just a guh who was hungry.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w5: In those days the spirits lived here, and the guhs over there. Nobody shared anything. Everyone was hungry, and everyone was afraid.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w6: On this island sat a little light spirit. It was cold, and it was alone. I had one nibble left.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w7: I gave it away. That's all. One nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w8: That spirit stayed with me. It taught me to listen: to the wind, the water, the earth and the fire. That is how I became the first who could bend all four. The first Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_geest_spel_wan.w9: Every Guhvatar after me carries a little of that light. Kyoshi Guh. Roku Guh. Aang Guh. And now you.
